prompt:
You are inspecting one cropped CCTV image of a person for personal protective equipment. Report ONLY what is plainly visible in THIS image. You are being graded on refusing to guess, not on filling every field. If the body part a question asks about is not clearly visible in this crop, the correct answer is "not_visible" — that is a complete and useful answer, and it is always better than a guess. Do not infer equipment from the uniform, the room, the person's apparent role, or what someone in this setting would normally wear. Do not assume a hand is gloved because the work looks like it needs gloves. Do not assume a head is covered because the job usually requires it. Do not assume a face is masked because the setting is a kitchen. Judge each body part independently: it is normal and expected for one to be visible and another not.
Respond with JSON containing exactly these 3 keys:
  "head_covering": one of ["none", "hairnet", "cap", "hood", "other", "not_visible"]
      Look at the TOP of the head. If any net, cap, hood, scarf or other fabric covers any part of the top of the head, answer with that covering — answer it EVEN IF loose hair is also visible below or around it, which is normal and does not make the head uncovered. Answer "none" ONLY if the top of the head is bare hair or scalp with nothing on it. Answer "not_visible" if the head is out of frame, cut off by the crop edge, turned fully away, blurred, or too small to judge — do not guess from the uniform or the setting.
  "face_covering": one of ["none", "mask", "mask_below_nose", "other", "not_visible"]
      Look at the FACE - the nose and mouth specifically. Answer "not_visible" if you are looking at the back or top of the head, if the face is turned away from the camera, or if it is cut off by the crop edge, blurred, or too small to judge. A face seen from the side IS visible - answer it normally. Answer "mask" ONLY if a mask or fabric covers BOTH the nose and the mouth. Answer "mask_below_nose" if a mask is on the person but sits below the nose, on the chin, or around the neck. Answer "other" for a face shield, visor or beard covering when nothing covers the nose and mouth. Answer "none" ONLY if you can actually see a bare nose and mouth with nothing on them.
  "hand_covering": one of ["none", "gloves", "not_visible"]
      Look at the HANDS themselves. Answer "not_visible" if the hands are out of frame, below the crop edge, behind the body, in a pocket, or inside a pot, bowl, sink, bag or any container — a hand you cannot see is not_visible even if you can see the arm going into something. A visible forearm, sleeve or cuff is NOT a visible hand. Answer "none" ONLY if you can actually see bare skin on a hand. Answer "gloves" ONLY if you can actually see a covering on a hand.
Never answer outside the listed options, and never guess to fill a key.
